: Disaster Events in the Taglish Disaster Tweet Dataset {#tbl-roster}

*Note.* Local names are assigned by PAGASA and international names by the Japan Meteorological Agency.

| Task | Labels |
|---|---|
| Named entity recognition | LOCATION, INFRASTRUCTURE |
| Intent classification | Rescue or immediate assistance, Casualty or missing persons, Displacement or evacuation, Infrastructure or utility damage, Donation needs or offers, Caution or advice, Other useful information, Not relevant |
| Urgency classification | Urgent, Standard, Low |

: Task Label Inventory for the Multi-Task Annotation Scheme {#tbl-labels}

*Note.* Intent categories follow the HumAID humanitarian taxonomy [@alam2021humaid]. Urgency levels adapt the urgent and non-urgent distinction of a prior scheme [@ermino2022urgency] to three levels, following the multi-level priority convention of TREC-IS [@wang2021transformer].
